entry.title: ProstoCAD 0.16.0: Much faster on big parts
entry.content:
Added

  • Interference in a part with several Solids: where a lid goes into its jar shows in red.
  • Edit Feature on a face or an edge; Edit on a Solid with the other Solids see-through.
  • Esc stops long work.
  • A new algorithm compares a part with its STL many times faster.
  • Project Geometry copies edges of another Solid into a sketch.

Fixed

  • Sketch tools, feature dialogs, a Boolean with a clearance and painted faces no longer hang on big parts.
  • A sketch in the middle of a part shows the part around it; a lid made by a Boolean no longer disappears.
  • Space hides and shows again.
